class.name: IfcPolyline
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO/CD 10303-42:1992 : A polyline is a bounded curve of n - 1 linear segments, defined by a list of n points, P 1 , P 2 ... P n . The i th segment of the curve is parameterized as follows: for 1 ≤ i ≤ n - 1 where i - 1 ≤ u ≤ i and with parametric range of 0 u ≤ n - 1. NOTE Corresponding ISO 10303 entity: polyline. Please refer to ISO/IS 10303-42:1994, p. 45 for the final definition
